messages:
Sam: OrionCloud just emailed — container holding at Port of Valencia. Marketplace reserved SKUs hit a 2-week delay. Want to triage reassignments now? :eyes:
Priya: which reservations?
Sam: `RESV-89321`, `RESV-89322` (GN10 racks). Original ETA Apr 10 -> now Apr 24 per vendor email.
Marco: if that holds we’ll miss part of the Dedicated ramp for Q2. Can partner do airfreight? Any compromise options?
Sam: partner said: "port congestion + manifest rework, earliest outbound slot is ~14 days. Air freight possible but +~12% cost and needs PO change" — forwarded the mail and manifest: https://vendor.orioncloud/manifest/RESV-89321
Lina: can we fallback to a marketplace SKU variant for the short term? We have `gn9-quant` and `gn8-int8` on the catalog that are compatible with the same model family. If we route 20% of traffic there we keep live SLAs while hardware arrives.
Priya: proposal: 20% reroute to `gn9-quant` for 2 weeks, keep 80% on reserved pool. Need approval from marketplace PM and SI (SOW changes). Also need to flag billing changes.
Jules: I’ll open a ticket with Marketplace PM + SI lead now and loop Legal for SOW amendment. Ticket: #MKPL-4521.
Marco: noted. If air option is chosen, estimate +12% infra cost + expedited customs fees. Approving partial reroute seems cheaper.
OrionBot: shipment-update: manifest RESV-89321 status -> HOLD_AT_PORT, last_scan 2026-04-02T11:04Z
Sam: ok — action items: (1) Jules to coordinate SOW tweak and SI routing, (2) Lina to propose routing config snippet, (3) Priya to coordinate billing/finance impact, (4) I’ll notify customers on dedicated ramp.
Lina: routing config to test (staging):
```
routing:
  policy: marketplace-fallback
  fallback_skus: ["gn9-quant","gn8-int8"]
  fallback_percent: 20
  window_days: 14
```
Priya: finance ok with provisional +12% on a per-reservation basis if air is used. For reroute we’ll bill by actual SKU usage.
Jules: ticket created and invited marketplace PM (@alice_mkt) + SI lead (@deepak_si). Will update thread after call.
Sam: thanks — keeping this open until manifest clears or we have confirmed reroute. I updated the tracking sheet: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/marketplace-capacity-tracker (row RESV-89321). :white_check_mark:
